SELECT edge.bucket AS bucket,
       t.currency AS dim_currency,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.mrr - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount) FROM billing.mrr_flows f
		WHERE f.merchant_id = t.merchant_id AND f.currency = t.currency AND f.measure NOT IN ('churn_voluntary', 'churn_chargeback')
		  AND f.bucket_at >= edge.bucket), 0)), 0)::bigint AS m_mrr
FROM unnest($2::timestamptz[]) AS edge(bucket)
LEFT JOIN billing.mrr_totals t ON t.merchant_id = $1
GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT edge.bucket AS bucket,
       'prod_' || pt.product_id::text AS dim_product_id,
       pt.currency AS dim_currency,
       COALESCE(SUM(pt.mrr - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pf.amount) FROM billing.mrr_product_flows pf
		WHERE pf.merchant_id = pt.merchant_id AND pf.currency = pt.currency AND pf.product_id = pt.product_id
		  AND pf.bucket_at >= edge.bucket), 0)), 0)::bigint AS m_mrr
FROM unnest($2::timestamptz[]) AS edge(bucket)
LEFT JOIN billing.mrr_product_totals pt ON pt.merchant_id = $1
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

		  AND f.bucket_at >= edge.bucket), 0)), 0)::bigint AS m_mrr

SELECT w.bucket AS bucket,
       t.currency AS dim_currency,
       COALESCE(SUM(-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sf.logos) FROM billing.mrr_streak_flows sf
			WHERE sf.merchant_id = t.merchant_id AND sf.currency = t.currency AND sf.measure = 'churn'
			  AND sf.bucket_at >= w.starts_at AND sf.bucket_at < w.ends_at AND sf.streak_at < w.starts_at), 0)), 0)::bigint AS m_trailing_churned,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.customers - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.logos) FROM billing.mrr_flows f
			WHERE f.merchant_id = t.merchant_id AND f.currency = t.currency AND f.measure NOT IN ('churn_voluntary', 'churn_chargeback')
			  AND f.bucket_at >= w.starts_at), 0)
			+ COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sf.logos) FROM billing.mrr_streak_flows sf
			WHERE sf.merchant_id = t.merchant_id AND sf.currency = t.currency AND sf.measure = 'correction'
			  AND sf.bucket_at >= w.starts_at AND sf.bucket_at < w.ends_at AND sf.streak_at < w.starts_at), 0)), 0)::bigint AS m_trailing_base
FROM unnest($2::timestamptz[], $3::timestamptz[], $4::timestamptz[]) AS w(bucket, starts_at, ends_at)
LEFT JOIN billing.mrr_totals t ON t.merchant_id = $1

SELECT COALESCE(-SUM(sf.logos * ct.sign) FILTER (WHERE sf.streak_at < $4::timestamptz), 0)::bigint AS m_churned_subscribers
FROM billing.mrr_streak_flows sf CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ct.churn_type, ct.sign FROM (VALUES
			('churn', 'involuntary', 1), ('churn_voluntary', 'voluntary', 1), ('churn_voluntary', 'involuntary', -1),
			('churn_chargeback', 'chargeback', 1), ('churn_chargeback', 'involuntary', -1)) ct(measure, churn_type, sign)
			WHERE ct.measure = sf.measure) ct
WHERE sf.merchant_id = $1
  AND sf.measure IN ('churn', 'churn_voluntary', 'churn_chargeback')
  AND sf.bucket_at >= $2
  AND sf.bucket_at < $3

WITH f AS (
	SELECT c.currency, date_trunc('month', c.cohort_at, $1) AS cohort, date_trunc('month', c.bucket_at, $1) AS month,
	       SUM(c.logos)::bigint AS logos, SUM(c.amount)::bigint AS amount
	FROM billing.mrr_cohort_flows c
	WHERE c.merchant_id = $2 AND c.cohort_at >= $3 AND c.cohort_at < $4 AND c.bucket_at < $4
	GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), a AS (
	SELECT cm.currency, date_trunc('month', cm.first_active_at, $1) AS cohort, count(*)::bigint AS members
	FROM billing.customer_mrr cm
	WHERE cm.merchant_id = $2 AND cm.first_active_at >= $3 AND cm.first_active_at < $4
	GROUP BY 1, 2
), g AS (
	SELECT k.currency, k.cohort, to_char(k.cohort AT TIME ZONE $1, 'YYYY-MM') AS cohort_label, m.n,
	       ((k.cohort AT TIME ZONE $1) + make_interval(months => m.n)) AT TIME ZONE $1 AS month
	FROM (SELECT currency, cohort FROM f UNION SELECT currency, cohort FROM a) k
	CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0, 1200) m(n)
	WHERE ((k.cohort AT TIME ZONE $1) + make_interval(months => m.n)) AT TIME ZONE $1 < $5
)
SELECT g.cohort_label AS dim_cohort,
       g.n::text AS dim_months_since_start,
       g.currency AS dim_currency,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN 'subscribers' = 'mrr' THEN f.amount ELSE f.logos END), 0)::bigint FROM f
			WHERE f.currency = g.currency AND f.cohort = g.cohort AND f.month <= g.month) AS m_cohort_value,
       CASE WHEN 'subscribers' = 'mrr' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN 'subscribers' = 'mrr' THEN f.amount ELSE f.logos END), 0)::bigint FROM f
			WHERE f.currency = g.currency AND f.cohort = g.cohort AND f.month <= g.cohort) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT a.members FROM a WHERE a.currency = g.currency AND a.cohort = g.cohort), 0) END AS m_cohort_size
FROM g CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('subscribers')) b(basis)
